observations.says: Amos Reed went up the tower stair at six
and came down it at nine
the stair is the only way up or down, and it comes down into the porch where Kit Sorrel sat
Hester Dent signed the vestry key out at half past seven
and signed it back at a quarter past eight: nobody else signed for it
Mr. Vane was at the Squire's bedside from five until half past nine
the cup was locked away at six, so it went between six and nine
the windows are barred: the only way into the vestry is its door, and so its key
Amos Reed was up the tower the whole time
Mr. Vane was at the Grange the whole time
Hester Dent had the vestry key from half past seven to a quarter past eight
